decisions.reason: Established polymer concrete drain housing is core to the drainage range with a dedicated web presence.
Floor-level shower drainage is central to the firm's offering and customer needs.
Flagship designer drainage product aligns strongly with the firm's premium, design-oriented direction.
Backflow-protected basement floor drain meets regulatory demand and occupies a dependable niche.
Air-admittance valve is a peripheral accessory outside the core drainage focus, so its resources are better reallocated.
